# CodeAzur

CodeAzur is a dark, code-focused theme with deep slate backgrounds and sky-blue accents. Code blocks follow a Night Owl style, and Inter is used for typography.

![CodeAzur screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orvpagadua/Code-Azur/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "CodeAzur"
    author: "orvpagadua"
    repo:   "orvpagadua/Code-Azur"
    slug:   "codeazur"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/codeazur"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/orvpagadua/Code-Azur"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orvpagadua/Code-Azur/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark, code-focused aesthetic with deep slate backgrounds and sky-blue accents. Display Night Owl–style code blocks and Inter typography for crisp, readable code and notes."
}
```
